liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue** (1 review): Jerry's emotional voice added feeling, seemingly singing the lines for Steve [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-12-31.154657.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 180 min [1]
- **gd1984-12-31.170342.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 179 min [2]
- **gd1984-12-31.akg.keshavan.miller.106684.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1984-12-31.154658.dts.tobin.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 179 min [7]
- **gd84-12-31.sbd.gorinsky.6395.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 175 min; rated 4.04/5 by 23 [8]. Said about its sound: Garcia's guitar tone shifts through scary, angry, sad, and happy sounds in the transition; The mono compressed radio sound is marginal, though the show itself is good; The sequence from Women to Spanish Jam is seamless and beautiful, best kept together [28][38][39]

## Around the show

- The band was overshadowed by the sadness of Steve's wife and daughter dying in an accident [28]
- The band opened with an anguished, rebellious performance, acknowledging the Parrish family loss [29]
- A huge wreath was placed by the stage to honor Parrish's loss [30]
- The opening notes were visceral, making the hairs on the listener's neck stand up [33]
- The show had higher energy than the previous two nights but was affected by tragedy [31]
- The show is a scorcher, with legendary Scarlet-Fire and Uncle John's Band performances [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-12-31.154657.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [1]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in December 2021 using rBrain Pro [1]
- **gd1984-12-31.170342.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [2]
- **gd1984-12-31.akg.keshavan.miller.106684.flac16**: taped by Rango Keshavan; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: AKG Mics -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) [4]. Also: National radio broadcast includes The Bobs and Dirty Dozen Brass Band, pitch-corrected by Joe B. Jones [4]
- **gd1984-12-31.154658.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix [7]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in December 2021 using rBrain Pro [7]
- **gd84-12-31.sbd.gorinsky.6395.sbeok.shnf**: source: SB > MR > ?? [apparently FM] > DAT > CDR > EAC> SHN [8]
